voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus finishes his tale and the Phaeacians sit in silence.

voice.speaker: alcinous
voice.caption: Bring out one more chest, and let every lord of Phaeacia add a tripod and a cauldron to it. Then set the feast, for our guest sails at sundown and he must leave us glad.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: At sunset Odysseus boards the convoy ship and lies on a prepared bed in the stern.

voice.speaker: phaeacian-convoy-crew-1
voice.caption: The crew carries the sleeping man and his treasure onto the shore.
